versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00248 The RTE shall calculate the needed buffer size for the output on which COMBased data transformation applies by using ceil (( end − start ) / 8 ) , where: • end is the ISignalToIPduMapping . startPosition plus the ISignal . length of the last ISignal of the ISignalGroup (the ISignal of this ISig- nalGroup having the highest ISignalToIPduMapping . startPosition in the related ISignalIPdu ), and • start is the ISignalToIPduMapping . startPosition of the first ISignal of the ISignalGroup (the ISignal of this ISignalGroup having the lowest ISignalToIPduMapping . startPosition in the related ISignalIPdu ).

The RTE shall calculate the needed buffer size for the output buffer size, on which COMBased data transformation applies by using the following for- mula OutputBu erLength = ( ISignalIPdu : Length ) where the ISignalIPdu references the respective ISignalGroup .
